cases.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
cases.evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

cases.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
cases.evidence: Total enrollment can be represented by `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

cases.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
cases.evidence: Valid charter number means the number is not null
cases.SQL: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

cases.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
cases.evidence: between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980 means the year = 1980
cases.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

cases.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
cases.evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'; respective counties means PARTITION BY County
cases.SQL: SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School,T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T2.County ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' ) ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5

cases.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
cases.evidence: incredibly poweful foils refers to cardKingdomFoilId is not null AND cardKingdomId is not null
cases.SQL: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

cases.question: What are the borderless cards available without powerful foils?
cases.evidence: borderless' refers to borderColor; poweful foils refers to cardKingdomFoilId paired with cardKingdomId AND cardKingdomId is not null
cases.SQL: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)

cases.question: How many cards have infinite power?
cases.evidence: infinite power refers to power = '*';
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

cases.question: What is the border color of card "Ancestor's Chosen"?
cases.evidence: name of card  = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' ;
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

cases.question: What is the rule of playing card "Benalish Knight"?
cases.evidence: Benalish Knight' is the name of card; rule of playing card refers to format;
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.name = 'Benalish Knight'

cases.question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
cases.evidence: "Harlan" and "Jarrod Dixon" are both DisplayName; highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation)
cases.SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') )

cases.question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
cases.evidence: account created in the year 2011 refers to year(CreationDate) = 2011
cases.SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'

cases.question: How many users last accessed the website after 2014/9/1?
cases.evidence: last accessed after 2014/9/1 refers to LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE date(LastAccessDate) > '2014-09-01'

cases.question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
cases.evidence: "csgillespie" is the DisplayName of user
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

cases.question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
cases.evidence: "Eliciting priors from experts" is the Title of post; owner refers to DisplayName
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

cases.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
cases.evidence: ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK = count(Currency = 'EUR') / count(Currency = 'CZK').
cases.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers

cases.question: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
cases.evidence: Between August And November 2013 refers to Between 201308 And 201311; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
cases.SQL: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

cases.question: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?
cases.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in gasstations table is 'CZE'; Slovakia can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'SVK';  Computation of more "discount" gas stations= Total no. of discount gas stations in Czech Republic - Total no. of discount gas stations in Slovakia
cases.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(Country = 'CZE', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(Country = 'SVK', 1, 0)) FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Discount'

cases.question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
cases.evidence: Amount of more SMEs = Total of SMEs pay using Currency CZK - Total of SMEs pay using Currency EUR
cases.SQL: SELECT SUM(Currency = 'CZK') - SUM(Currency = 'EUR') FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

cases.question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
cases.evidence: February 2012 refers to '201202' in yearmonth.date; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
cases.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Consumption > 528.3, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'

cases.question: Give the team_fifa_api_id of teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed.
cases.evidence: teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed refers to buildUpPlaySpeed >50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed <60;
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

cases.question: Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag.
cases.evidence: average number of long shot = DIVIDE(SUM(long_shots), COUNT(player_fifa_api_id));
cases.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.`date`) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

cases.question: List the football players with a birthyear of 1970 and a birthmonth of October.
cases.evidence: players with a birthyear of 1970 and a birthmonth of October refers to substr(birthday,1,7) AS 'year-month',WHERE year = '1970' AND month = '10';
cases.SQL: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'

cases.question: What is the overall rating of the football player Gabriel Tamas in year 2011?
cases.evidence: in year 2011 refers to strftime('%Y', date) = '2011';
cases.SQL: SELECT t2.overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '2011'

cases.question: Which player is older, Aaron Lennon or Abdelaziz Barrada?
cases.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
cases.SQL: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
cases.evidence: A11 refers to average salary; Female mapps to gender = 'F'
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id)  FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

cases.question: For the female client who was born in 1976/1/29, which district did she opened her account?
cases.evidence: Female refers to gender = 'F'; A2 refers to district names
cases.SQL: SELECT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.birth_date = '1976-01-29' AND T2.gender = 'F'

cases.question: List all the withdrawals in cash transactions that the client with the id 3356 makes.
cases.evidence: operation = 'VYBER' refers to withdrawal in cash
cases.SQL: SELECT T4.trans_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.client_id = 3356 AND T4.operation = 'VYBER'

cases.question: How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region?
cases.evidence: A3 contains the data of region; 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' represents for 'issuance after transaction'.
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

cases.question: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?
cases.evidence: Male means that gender = 'M'; A3 refers to region; A11 pertains to average salary.
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000

cases.question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
cases.evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.
cases.evidence: Germany is a name of country;
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'Germany'

cases.question: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
cases.evidence: coordinate position/location refers to lat, lng; circuits for Australian grand prix refers to races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

cases.question: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
cases.evidence: coordinate position/location refers to lat, lng; Abu Dhabi Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

cases.question: What's Bruno Senna's Q1 result in the qualifying race No. 354?
cases.evidence: race number refers to raceId; Bruno Senna refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
cases.SQL: SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 354 AND T2.forename = 'Bruno' AND T2.surname = 'Senna'

cases.question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
cases.evidence: Angela Sanders is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; major refers to major_name.
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

cases.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
cases.evidence: 'Vice President' is a position of Student Club; funds received refers to amount.
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

cases.question: List the full name of the Student_Club members that grew up in Illinois state.
cases.evidence: full name of member refers to first_name, last_name
cases.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois'

cases.question: What was the notes of the fundraising on 2019/9/14?
cases.evidence: fundraising on 2019/9/14 refers to source = 'Fundraising' where date_received = '2019-09-14'
cases.SQL: SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

cases.question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
cases.evidence: Carlo Jacobs is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
cases.SQL: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

cases.question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
cases.evidence: 3-D Man refers to superhero_name = '3-D Man'; superpowers refers to power_name
cases.SQL: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

cases.question: What is Copycat's race?
cases.evidence: Copycat is the superhero_name;
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Copycat'

cases.question: Which superheroes have a durability attribute value of less than 50?
cases.evidence: durability of less than 50 refers to attribute_name = 'Durability' AND attribute_value < 50
cases.SQL: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS T2 INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND T2.attribute_value < 50 AND T1.id = T2.hero_id)

cases.question: Give the publisher ID of Star Trek.
cases.evidence: Star Trek is the publisher_name;
cases.SQL: SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'

cases.question: What is the total number of superheroes without full name?
cases.evidence: superheroes without full name refers to full_name IS NULL
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL

cases.question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
cases.evidence: '30609' is the Patient ID; disease means Diagnosis
cases.SQL: SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 30609

cases.question: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
cases.evidence: LDH beyond normal range refers to LDH > '500';
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500

cases.question: For patients with severe degree of thrombosis, list their ID, sex and disease the patient is diagnosed with.
cases.evidence: severe degree of thrombosis refers to thrombosis = 2; disease refers to diagnosis;
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

cases.question: What are the symptoms observed by the youngest patient to ever did a medical examination? Identify their diagnosis.
cases.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; symptoms observed refers to the symptoms is not NULL
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
cases.evidence: female refers to SEX = 'F'; APS diagnosis refers to Diagnosis='APS'
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

cases.question: What is the most common bond type?
cases.evidence: most common bond type refers MAX(COUNT(bond_type))
cases.SQL: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

cases.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
cases.evidence: triple-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '#'; carcinogenic refers to label = '+'
cases.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

cases.question: What is the percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with three decimal places.
cases.evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+'), COUNT(molecule_id)) as percent
cases.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '+' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.molecule_id),3) FROM molecule t

cases.question: How many connections does the atom 19 have?
cases.evidence: connections refers to bond_id; atom 19 refers to atom_id like 'TR%_19';
cases.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM connected AS T WHERE SUBSTR(T.atom_id, -2) = '19'

cases.question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
cases.evidence: TR041 is the molecule id; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
cases.SQL: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T3.molecule_id = 'TR041'
